about: Engine 2's worksheet map (docs/taxes.md "The tax engines"): how Tax-Calculator's outputs relate, written from its calcfunctions.py (scripts/taxcalc_map_skeleton.py prints each output's inputs). A formula names outputs (read back by taxcalc_run.py), record inputs and law parameters (dollars, for the year and filing status); `x * 0.5` is a rate, `int(65)` a count, `if_(condition, then, else)` a branch, and a name under `parts` stands for its formula. Each run checks every formula against the engine's own value: one that doesn't reproduce it is shown as the engine's value only, and the conformance test fails. Reviewed against the pinned release and law file below: a different one isn't used.

ymod1.label: Income before adjustments
ymod1.cite: Form 1040 lines 1-8 and Schedule 1 Part I

ymod.label: Income for the Social Security worksheet

c02500.label: Taxable Social Security benefits
c02500.formula: if_(ymod < SS_thd1, 0, if_(ymod < SS_thd2, min(ymod - SS_thd1, e02400) * 0.5, min((ymod - SS_thd2) * 0.85 + min(e02400, SS_thd2 - SS_thd1) * 0.5, e02400 * 0.85)))

setax.label: Self-employment tax
setax.formula: min(net_se_p, SS_Earnings_c - min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200p + pencon_p)) * 0.124 + net_se_p * 0.029 + min(net_se_s, SS_Earnings_c - min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200s + pencon_s)) * 0.124 + net_se_s * 0.029

standard.label: Standard deduction, with the charitable deduction for non-itemizers
standard.formula: if_(c04470 > 0, 0, STD + STD_Aged * (if_(age_head >= int(65), int(1), int(0)) + if_(MARS == int(2) and age_spouse >= int(65), int(1), int(0))) + min(e19800, STD_charity_ded_nonitemizers_max))
standard.note: Tax-Calculator keeps only the deduction taken: the standard deduction is 0 when it itemizes, and itemized deductions are 0 when it doesn't.

c04800.label: Taxable income
c04800.formula: max0(max0(c00100 - max(c04470, standard) - c04600 - (senior_deduction + overtime_income_deduction + tip_income_deduction + auto_loan_interest_deduction)) - qbided)

c05800.label: Tax with the alternative minimum tax

ptax_amc.label: Additional Medicare tax
ptax_amc.formula: max0(wages_medicare - AMEDT_ec) * 0.009 + max0(net_se_p + net_se_s - max0(AMEDT_ec - wages_medicare)) * 0.009

refund.label: Refundable credits
refund.formula: eitc + c11070 + c10960 + recovery_rebate_credit + CDCC_refund + personal_refundable_credit + ctc_new

opaque.taxbc: Tax on taxable income (the rate schedules and the capital gains worksheet)
opaque.c07180: Child and dependent care credit, limited to the tax
opaque.c07230: Education credits, limited to the tax
opaque.c07220: Child tax credit, limited to the tax
opaque.odc: Credit for other dependents, limited to the tax
opaque.c07200: Credit for the elderly or disabled
opaque.CDCC_refund: Refundable child and dependent care credit

facts.e00900s: Your spouse's business profit or loss
facts.e09900: 10% on early distributions and 20% on HSA money not spent on medical care
facts.MARS: Filing status (1 single, 2 married filing jointly, 4 head of household)
